part_name_cn: X轴龙门横梁同步带直线模组
recommended_spec: Travel 450-500 mm; mounted on gantry beam; carries Z module and gripper
candidate_model_or_series: MISUMI belt-driven actuator or equivalent industrial belt linear module
supplier_candidate: MISUMI; THK; HIWIN-equivalent linear actuator suppliers
fallback_model_strategy: Not allowed for design freeze; envelope fallback only before real CAD
material: Aluminum body; steel rails; belt and pulley set
function: Provides X horizontal motion on the gantry beam
selection_reason: X-on-gantry module defines Z adapter position and gantry beam mounting holes
risk_note: Exact model depends on gantry beam stiffness, moving mass, motor side, and CAD availability
next_action: Select candidate module after gantry beam envelope is fixed

part_name_en: Left Y-axis module or guide assembly
recommended_spec: Travel 260-300 mm; left-side support/drive datum; synchronized with right side
candidate_model_or_series: MISUMI belt-driven actuator, linear guide plus belt drive, or equivalent left Y module
fallback_model_strategy: Not allowed for design freeze; fallback only for rough layout
material: Aluminum body; steel rails; belt/pulley if integrated
function: Left Y support and possible drive side for gantry beam
selection_reason: Left side defines gantry datum, motor/sync input, and base mounting holes
risk_note: Wrong left-side datum can cause gantry skew and binding
next_action: Download real CAD before base and gantry connection holes are frozen

recommended_spec: Travel 120 mm; vertical holding; low backlash; compact carriage
candidate_model_or_series: MISUMI lead-screw actuator; THK/KRK style compact actuator or equivalent
fallback_model_strategy: Not allowed for design freeze; envelope fallback only
material: Aluminum body; steel guide; steel lead screw
function: Provides vertical pick/place motion
selection_reason: Lead screw is preferred for vertical holding and controlled low-speed descent
risk_note: Backlash, brake/holding behavior, and lead efficiency affect PID and motor sizing
next_action: Choose lead, carriage height, and motor mount after gripper mass estimate

recommended_spec: Stepper or servo motor compatible with X-on-gantry belt module
candidate_model_or_series: NEMA23 closed-loop stepper or compact AC servo series; final model TBD
supplier_candidate: MISUMI; Oriental Motor; Leadshine; Delta; equivalent
fallback_model_strategy: No fallback for final motor envelope; placeholder only for rough space
function: Drives X belt module on gantry
selection_reason: X axis needs speed and acceleration; closed-loop stepper or small servo reduces missed-step risk
risk_note: Torque-speed curve and belt pulley inertia must be matched to actual module
next_action: Estimate X thrust then shortlist motor series with torque-speed data

recommended_spec: Single motor preferred for mechanically synchronized left/right Y axis; dual motor only with added sync-control risk document
candidate_model_or_series: NEMA23 closed-loop stepper or compact servo; final model TBD
supplier_candidate: MISUMI; Oriental Motor; Leadshine; Delta; equivalent
fallback_model_strategy: No fallback for final motor envelope; placeholder only for rough space
function: Drives mechanically synchronized Y gantry system
selection_reason: Single motor plus mechanical synchronization reduces left/right mismatch risk
risk_note: If dual motors are later used, anti-jamming and synchronization control must be documented
next_action: Estimate gantry mass and choose motor after Y sync architecture is selected

recommended_spec: Stepper or servo motor with holding torque margin for vertical screw axis
candidate_model_or_series: NEMA17/NEMA23 closed-loop stepper or compact servo with brake option; final model TBD
supplier_candidate: MISUMI; Oriental Motor; Leadshine; Delta; equivalent
fallback_model_strategy: No fallback for final motor envelope; placeholder only for rough space
function: Drives Z lead screw module
selection_reason: Z axis requires gravity load margin and stable holding during pick/place
risk_note: Brake or self-locking requirement depends on screw lead and safety review
next_action: Calculate Z thrust and lead-screw torque with gripper mass

part_name_en: X/Y/Z linear guide rails and carriage blocks
recommended_spec: Compact guide rails and sliders if not integrated into selected modules
candidate_model_or_series: THK LM Guide miniature/compact series; HIWIN MGN/MGW class; MISUMI equivalent
fallback_model_strategy: Not allowed for rail hole and slider height freeze
function: Guides X/Y/Z axes if modules are not fully integrated
selection_reason: Real rail CAD defines hole spacing, block height, and assembly datums
risk_note: Counterfeit or generic guide geometry can cause wrong mounting interfaces
next_action: Download real configured guide CAD after module choice

recommended_spec: GT/HTD class belt sized for X and Y synchronized gantry drives
candidate_model_or_series: GT2/GT3/HTD timing belt series; exact width and pitch TBD
cad_format_preference: STEP if available; supplier catalog data
fallback_model_strategy: Belt path may be represented only after pulley and module selected
material: Rubber or polyurethane with tensile cord
function: Transmits motor torque to X and Y carriages
selection_reason: Timing belt suits fast horizontal axes and mechanical synchronization
risk_note: Belt stretch affects repeatability, synchronization, and control stiffness
next_action: Choose pitch, width, reinforcement, and length after load estimate

recommended_spec: Pulley bore matching motor/sync shaft; tooth count selected for speed/torque tradeoff
candidate_model_or_series: GT/HTD timing pulley series; exact tooth count TBD
fallback_model_strategy: No final fallback because bore and tooth geometry affect layout
function: Converts motor/sync shaft torque to belt force
selection_reason: Pulley radius directly affects torque, synchronization, and resolution
risk_note: Incorrect bore/key/set-screw details can break Y sync interface
next_action: Select pulley tooth count after motor speed and belt pitch choice

recommended_spec: Lead selected for 120 mm Z travel; low backlash nut; efficiency TBD
candidate_model_or_series: T8/trapezoidal or ball screw class; exact lead TBD
fallback_model_strategy: Not allowed for final thread/nut interface; envelope fallback only
material: Steel screw; bronze/POM/steel nut depending type
function: Converts rotary motion to Z linear motion
selection_reason: Lead screw supports controlled vertical motion and holding behavior
risk_note: Backlash and efficiency strongly affect control and holding torque
next_action: Choose trapezoidal vs ball screw after safety and precision review

recommended_spec: Motor shaft to screw/pulley/sync shaft coupling; bore sizes TBD
candidate_model_or_series: Flexible jaw or beam coupling series
fallback_model_strategy: No final fallback because bore and length define shaft stack
function: Connects motor shaft to drive shaft or lead screw
selection_reason: Flexible coupling tolerates small alignment errors
risk_note: Wrong bore size or coupling stiffness may cause vibration/backlash
next_action: Finalize after motor shaft and screw/pulley/sync shaft diameters are known

recommended_spec: Support bearing block for pulley shaft, sync shaft, or screw end; bore matched to shaft
candidate_model_or_series: Pillow block/flanged bearing block/BK-BF style compact support
fallback_model_strategy: Envelope fallback only until bore and mounting holes confirmed
material: Steel or aluminum housing; bearing steel
function: Supports rotating belt, screw, or Y sync shafts
selection_reason: Bearing supports reduce shaft deflection and define drive alignment
risk_note: Mounting hole pattern and bearing preload vary by supplier
next_action: Select with shaft size and gantry packaging

recommended_spec: Stroke suitable for 13 mm tube; soft pad interface; compact vertical mounting
candidate_model_or_series: SMC LEH/LEHF class; Festo EHPS class; equivalent electric gripper
fallback_model_strategy: No fallback for design freeze; gripper CAD required for flange and mass
material: Aluminum body; steel guide; elastomer pad optional
function: Grips and releases blood sample tube
selection_reason: Electric gripper avoids pneumatic system and supports controllable stroke/force
risk_note: Tube damage risk requires force control or compliant pads
next_action: Choose gripper after tube contact geometry and mass are confirmed

recommended_spec: Silicone or TPU pads shaped for 13 mm cylindrical tube; replaceable
candidate_model_or_series: Custom pad or supplier accessory pad; exact geometry TBD
cad_source: Supplier accessory CAD or custom drawing
fallback_model_strategy: Temporary simplified pad acceptable for envelope; final pad needs drawing/material
function: Protects tube and increases grip friction
selection_reason: Soft pad reduces glass/plastic stress and slipping
risk_note: Material hardness and sterilization compatibility need review
next_action: Define pad hardness, contact radius, and attachment method after gripper selection

recommended_spec: Small e-chain for gantry, X carriage, and Z/gripper moving cables
candidate_model_or_series: igus E2 micro or equivalent small e-chain series
fallback_model_strategy: Fallback allowed for routing envelope only; final chain CAD preferred
function: Routes and protects moving cables
selection_reason: igus and similar suppliers provide configurable chain CAD and bend radius data
risk_note: Cable fill ratio and bend radius must be checked
next_action: Select cable list then configure chain size and length

recommended_spec: Compact mechanical or inductive home/limit switch for dual Y, X, and Z axes
candidate_model_or_series: Omron/Panasonic/MISUMI micro switch or proximity switch class
fallback_model_strategy: No final fallback for safety switch mounting
function: Home and travel limit detection
selection_reason: Limit switches are required for commissioning and safe travel control
risk_note: Switch actuation direction and repeatability affect homing precision
next_action: Choose switch type and actuator targets after axis CAD

recommended_spec: Compact sensor for tube/rack presence; bracket mountable
candidate_model_or_series: SICK/Keyence/Omron photoelectric sensor class
fallback_model_strategy: No final fallback for sensor bracket freeze
function: Detects tube or rack presence
selection_reason: Industrial sensor supports reliable non-contact detection
risk_note: Exact sensing distance and mounting angle must be verified
next_action: Select sensor after workspace and bracket location are fixed

recommended_spec: Compact barcode scanner envelope near gripper or fixed station
candidate_model_or_series: Keyence/SICK/Datalogic compact barcode reader class
fallback_model_strategy: Fallback allowed for visual envelope until scanner selected
function: Represents barcode scanning module for sample identification
selection_reason: Barcode reader is needed for sample traceability but model can be envelope-first
risk_note: Real scanner availability and data interface not frozen
next_action: Define scan strategy and select scanner series later

recommended_spec: 22 mm panel mount mushroom E-stop; safety-rated; front accessible
candidate_model_or_series: Schneider/Siemens/IDEC class 22 mm emergency stop
fallback_model_strategy: No fallback for final safety panel layout
function: Operator emergency stop
selection_reason: Safety-related part must use real rated component
risk_note: Electrical safety circuit is outside current CAD-only scope
next_action: Choose rated E-stop and contact block family

recommended_spec: Electrical enclosure for controller, drives, power supply; size TBD
candidate_model_or_series: Hammond/Rittal/McMaster enclosure class
fallback_model_strategy: Fallback allowed for early enclosure envelope; final enclosure CAD preferred
function: Houses control electronics
selection_reason: A standard enclosure improves manufacturability and cable management
risk_note: Thermal, grounding, and access requirements not yet defined
next_action: Estimate electronics volume and choose enclosure size

part_name_en: Aluminum extrusion or support frame components
recommended_spec: 2020/2040 class or industrial profile for supports and guards; length TBD
candidate_model_or_series: MISUMI aluminum extrusion; Bosch Rexroth-compatible profile
fallback_model_strategy: Fallback allowed for early frame envelope; final cut list required
function: Supports frame, enclosure, sensor mounts, or auxiliary brackets
selection_reason: Profiles are modular and easy to adapt during design iteration
risk_note: Slot standard and fastener compatibility must be consistent
next_action: Choose profile family and slot standard before detailed frame design

recommended_spec: Profile corner brackets matching chosen extrusion slot
candidate_model_or_series: T-slot angle bracket series matching selected extrusion family
fallback_model_strategy: Fallback allowed for early visualization; final bracket CAD preferred
function: Connects aluminum profiles and guard frame
selection_reason: Standard brackets reduce custom machining
risk_note: Depends on selected profile series
next_action: Select after extrusion family is fixed

recommended_spec: M3/M4/M5 socket head screws, T-nuts, washers, dowel pins as needed
candidate_model_or_series: ISO/DIN socket head screws, washers, T-nuts, and dowel pin families
cad_format_preference: STEP optional; BOM table sufficient for common fasteners
fallback_model_strategy: Generic fastener library acceptable until release BOM
function: Assembly fastening
selection_reason: Common fasteners can be selected after hole sizes and materials are fixed
risk_note: Over-modeling every screw may slow CAD; release BOM still needs exact sizes
next_action: Define fastener standard and preferred material in drawing phase

part_name_cn: 透明PC防护罩相关标准件
recommended_spec: Transparent PC panels, hinges, handles, latches, rubber bumpers, panel clips
candidate_model_or_series: McMaster-Carr guard hardware; MISUMI panel accessories; equivalent
cad_format_preference: STEP for hinges/latches; drawings for panels
fallback_model_strategy: Fallback allowed for guard envelope; final hardware CAD/drawings required
function: Provides operator protection and visibility
selection_reason: Protective cover is required for moving axes and sample area
risk_note: Panel thickness, door access, and interlock requirements not yet frozen
next_action: Define guard concept, access doors, and hardware list later

part_name_en: Right Y-axis module or guide assembly
recommended_spec: Travel 260-300 mm; right-side support/guide datum; synchronized with left side
candidate_model_or_series: MISUMI belt-driven actuator, linear guide plus belt drive, or equivalent right Y module
fallback_model_strategy: Not allowed for design freeze; fallback only for rough layout
material: Aluminum body; steel rails; belt/pulley if integrated
function: Right Y support and synchronized guide side for gantry beam
selection_reason: Right side must match left side height, rail datum, and carriage interface
risk_note: Mismatch between left/right CAD can cause gantry binding
next_action: Download matching right-side CAD and verify symmetry with SP-002

recommended_spec: Single motor synchronization shaft or belt linkage for left/right Y axis
candidate_model_or_series: Timing shaft, pulleys, belts, couplings, and bearing supports; exact design TBD
fallback_model_strategy: Not allowed for design freeze because synchronization geometry is critical
material: Steel shaft; aluminum/steel pulleys; bearings; belts
function: Mechanically links left and right Y motion
selection_reason: Mechanical sync reduces risk of dual-motor mismatch and gantry skew
risk_note: Shaft alignment, belt tension, and bearing placement can cause binding if wrong
next_action: Select synchronization layout after left/right Y module CAD is reviewed

recommended_spec: Beam end plates, carriage adapters, beam fasteners, dowel pins, and alignment hardware
candidate_model_or_series: Supplier brackets or custom-compatible hardware; exact set TBD
cad_format_preference: STEP optional; drawings for custom plates
fallback_model_strategy: Fallback not allowed for final beam-to-carriage interfaces
material: 6061-T6 aluminum plates; steel fasteners; dowel pins
function: Connects gantry beam to left/right Y carriages and supports X module
selection_reason: Gantry beam hardware controls squareness, stiffness, and X-axis datum
risk_note: Weak or inaccurate beam interfaces reduce placement accuracy
next_action: Define after Y carriage CAD and X-on-gantry module CAD are available
